review_summary: The final report presents 5 behavior-chain entries: three alert-only explorer/cmd/tshark/dumpcap entries in Chain A, one Discord-to-cmd entry in Chain B, and one Firefox entry in Chain C. Chain B gives non-alert CBC evidence for cmd.exe pid 4872 under discord.exe with command_line C:\Windows\system32\cmd.exe /q /d /s /c nvidia-smi.exe, so both C09 gold behaviors are recovered in order by content. Chain A relies on CBC alert rows and Chain C is unrelated, so they are denominator-only extras; alert summary text is not credited as non-alert evidence.

The final report presents three substantive non-alert behavior groups for the target chain: Discord.exe creating cmd.exe, cmd.exe carrying the /q /d /s /c nvidia-smi command line, and extra cmd.exe module/file/termination activity. The first two recover C09-S01 and C09-S02 in order using CBC EDR/NGAV telemetry. The module/file/termination group is denominator-only extra content; the CBC alert summary is treated as supporting context only and is not credited as non-alert evidence.
